final_message:
All 6 tests pass. Two bugs fixed in `lrucache/cache.py`:

1. **`get` didn't refresh recency** — a hit returned the value without `move_to_end`, so recently-read keys could be evicted. Now a hit moves the key to the MRU end.
2. **`put` evicted on updates** — the capacity check evicted the LRU entry even when the key already existed. Now eviction only happens when inserting a *new* key into a full cache.

`SOLUTION.md` written with the root-cause summary.
